source: Arbitrum One eth_getLogs (USDC Transfer + Variational SettlementPool/Factory events), independently indexed

coverage.note: rows cover every block from first_block to last_block; the final row is partial when partial=true

reconciliation.method: Multicall3 aggregate3 of USDC.balanceOf for every pool and system address at the as-of block

method: One row per UTC day (midnight blocks found by binary search on block timestamps). User deposits = SettlementPool Deposited events paid by a non-system wallet plus onboarding-router and atomic deposits; withdrawals = Withdrawn events; settlement, fees and payouts = USDC Transfer logs between pools and Variational system addresses. Pool balances are the running sum of every indexed movement. Amounts in USDC, 2 decimals. Wallet roles for referral_claims and loss_refunds are inferred from flow shape and match Variational's disclosed cumulative totals.

definitions.accounts_first_funded: pools receiving their first user deposit that day
definitions.pools_first_inflow: pools receiving their first USDC of any kind that day (deposit, settlement or payout)
definitions.net_flow: user deposits minus user withdrawals; new = accounts first funded that day, returning = all others
definitions.pool_balance_change: end-of-day change in all-pool balance (deposits - withdrawals + settlement in - settlement out - fees + payouts); new = pools with their first inflow that day, returning = all others
definitions.active_pools: pools with any USDC movement that day (deposit, withdrawal, settlement, fee, payout)
definitions.active_pools_user_initiated: pools with a user deposit or withdrawal that day
definitions.pools_live: pools with a USDC balance > 0 at end of day
definitions.pools_dormant: pools that received USDC at some point and hold 0 at end of day
definitions.pools_balance_ge_1usd: pools holding at least 1 USDC at end of day
definitions.direct_transfers_to_pools: plain ERC-20 transfers sent straight to a pool by a non-system wallet (no pool event); counted in balances, not in deposits
definitions.settlement_to_pools: Core OLP Vault -> pool (direct, via settlement router, or via Oracle)
definitions.fees_from_pools: Oracle.collectFees pulls: pool -> treasury / referral reward pool / legacy fee wallet / other provider
definitions.payouts_to_pools: Oracle.transferFromOLPToPool from a non-vault system wallet (referral pool, legacy wallet) into a pool
definitions.referral_claims: payouts_to_pools funded by wallet 0x6c3d445b... (referral reward pool; label inferred, cumulative total tracks the officially disclosed referral rewards on 17 bi-weekly reports)
definitions.loss_refunds: payouts_to_pools funded by wallet 0xc4775613... (loss refund pool, 5 Sep 2025 to 24 Mar 2026; label inferred, cumulative total matches the officially disclosed losses refunded on 6 and 20 Mar 2026)
